method: paired mean difference with two-sided 95% Student-t confidence interval
evidence_scope: Exploratory directional smoke test. The committed default is ten paired seeds; this run is not powered to establish equivalence, select protocol parameters, or show that an unobserved practically important effect is absent.
difference_direction: specified certificate-inclusion qualification minus announcement-time qualification

notes: Both arms run the adopted configuration. The single difference is where the EB threshold-or-age qualification binds: at announcement with the announcing RB's count (historical), or at certificate inclusion with the certifying RB counted (specified). Under the historical policy the earliest below-threshold certificate lands one RB later than the specified rule allows, so the historical arm is expected to be conservative for trickle standard latency.
The age escape binds at trickle load, so trickle-0p1 is the decision-facing load. Where the byte threshold gates announcements, the arms coincide.
Independent streams align fresh-demand samples and Ranking Block opportunities within a seed; retry jitter remains mechanism-dependent.
Launch-day urgent-class slices are omitted because that profile changes the urgency-rate multiplier over time; priority-lane metrics remain usable.
